editorial.blurb: Lone Owl is a lively gastropub where excellent cocktails and genuine hospitality shine, anchored by creative Pacific Northwest-inspired dishes.
editorial.insiderTip: Head straight to the bar for the best experience—the bartenders (Iliana and others) are attentive and craft excellent drinks, while table service can be inconsistent; order the dill-dusted popcorn and a cold Chicago Old Style on a warm afternoon.
